item.text:
The settings page now shows whether notifications are on or off and provides a toggle button. The [Server Action](/workspace/app/actions.ts:6) saves the preference in a browser cookie, then calls Next.js’s `refresh()` from `next/cache` to update the current page without redirecting to another page. The [page](/workspace/app/page.tsx:4) reads the updated value when it renders.

I added the required [root layout](/workspace/app/layout.tsx:3). The production build and TypeScript check passed. Because this app has no account or database layer, the preference is stored per browser.
